      "record": "Mongolian Law of 19 April 2002, approval of documents from inspection of the state border",

      "finding": "The enacted law confirms a 1987–2001 joint Mongolia–Russia border inspection and approval of four instruments: a line-description protocol, map album, boundary-marker protocols, and a coordinate catalogue for boundary markers/geodetic starting points. Article 2 approves line changes found in that inspection. The official page's documented export is one page of the approval act; its annex path is empty and it supplies none of the four underlying instruments. This is material source-specific context but does not tie any marker or segment to these eight cells."
    },

      "record": "Mongolian ratification law of 4 October 2007 for the Russia–Mongolia State Border Regime Treaty signed 8 December 2006",
      "url": "https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail/9998",

  "access_and_effort": {
    "official_law_attachment_route": "Inspected the official Law 9486 page and documented export implementation. The export is only the law text; the annex-download control has an empty path. This was actually tested, not inferred from extracted text alone.",
    "official_geospatial_route": "The Mongolian agency announcement says the NSDI boundary layer is served as SHP/GeoJSON/GML via WMS/WFS/download after DAN authentication. Public portal pages were inspected but expose no concrete data body/locator in their public response. No login or credentials were attempted.",
    "wms": "Advertised public WMS GetMap and GetFeatureInfo succeeded and actual line geometry was retained. No full-world source hydration occurred.",
    "wfs": "Capabilities returned a service exception, 'Service WFS is disabled'. WFS remains stopped; no retry or alternative endpoint.",
    "other_recorded_limits": [
      "UN Digital Library document request returned 403; it was not retried or routed through an alternate host.",
      "Russian MID page had prior 502/TLS-verified connection failures and was not retried in this assessment.",
      "President.mn page had a prior 403 and remained stopped."
    ],
    "result": "The specifically identified official map/marker/coordinate records were pursued through the documented public legalinfo export and bounded publication searches; none was located in the opened public record. The remaining instrument-level step is a public copy or authorized release of at least the relevant map-album sheet or coordinate-catalogue entries. The evidence does not establish global unavailability."
  },
  "contract_assessment": {
    "positive_path": "None of the eight can be assigned to Russia or Mongolia based on this record. Original source polygons and point coverage establish the retained 2017 source contact, not which side is controlling. The 2025 LSIB line gives proximity and participants, not sidedness; the 2002 law establishes that approved line changes exist but omits the underlying locators.",
    "researched_unresolved": "The record supports proposing researched-unresolved treatment for these exact eight contacts under the original contract: substantial source-specific research located the enacted approval law, verified that it approves line changes and identifies the specific map/marker/coordinate instruments, inspected the official publication route and its empty annex path, checked the current official-publisher policy-line context by successful WMS, and preserved the exact source/physical joins. Those sources still do not resolve the key-level side or applicability contradiction. Keep all eight native holds and all other RUS groups unchanged; root must make any completion-credit decision separately.",
    "not_a_gate": "Neither a universal current-boundary certificate nor a numerical accuracy threshold is imposed. The missing evidence is narrowly tied to the actual MNG/RUS source contact and expressly identified instruments in the 2002 law."
  },
